official_source_revalidation.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
official_source_revalidation.series: UK local authority and regional greenhouse gas emissions statistics, 2005 to 2024

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: The previous canonical matrix URL ignored refresh=gas100, opened Security by default and rendered only 25 rows.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: A same-origin shard-scoped harness now selects Gas Emissions and traverses canonical pages 1 through 4.

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: Child PowerShell scripts depended on git being available on system PATH.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Wrapper and carrier resolve portable git from AAYS_PORTABLE_ROOT before system PATH fallback.

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: The previous matrix gate accepted text saying 100 rows without counting exact rendered rows.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Carrier now requires exactly 100 serialized acceptance-row markers and 28 serialized acceptance-header markers.

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: PASS text and header names also existed in JavaScript source and could contribute to false-positive text matching.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Runtime-only completion, page-count, page-size, unique-row, row and header DOM attributes are required.
